violated_contract: Every entrypoint that deletes a user's conversation must remove the same stored content as the app's DELETE /v1/conversations/{id}. The Developer API delete only removed the Firestore document, so the conversation's photo and screen-frame images stayed in GCS (with no path left to find them, because their ids lived under the deleted document) and its conversation and transcript-chunk vectors stayed searchable.
canonical_prevention: A second delete entrypoint runs the app route's cleanup sequence, in its order (screen frames and frame evidence before the parent document, vectors after), and a test executes the entrypoint with recording collaborators and asserts that sequence, so a cleanup step added to one route and not the other fails the suite.
